subject: A large, expressive Allosaurus sitting in a lush, sun-drenched prehistoric glade.
pose: The Allosaurus is sitting back on its haunches, looking slightly cross-eyed with a pained but endearing expression. It has its mouth slightly open, showing a glowing pink 'sore' spot on its gums. It is holding its jaw with its three-fingered hands (medial palm orientation).

typography.style: 3D thick block letters, bright red glossy finish, soft beveled edges
typography.placement: Center-top, slightly arched over the dinosaur's head
typography.effects: Subtle ambient occlusion where the letters meet the air, making them feel like a physical part of the 3D environment.

visual_logic.cleanliness_factor: The foreground is a clean, mossy patch with a few oversized, stylized ferns. No messy dirt or grit to distract from the title or the character.
visual_logic.character_fidelity: High-fidelity skin textures with subtle specular highlights on the scales; expressive, wet-looking eyes that convey personality.
